section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a single study (Study X) consisting of 288 Portuguese women from the general population, aged 18-50 (M = 30.44). The sample had a mean BMI of 23.93, with the majority (63.2%) presenting normal BMI. Years of schooling ranged from 4 to 23 (M = 13.76), but specific education level percentages and racial composition are not provided.
